text:
Sara: Heads-up — RC2 build waiting on PR #9124 (model-routing fallback). Need 2x LGTM before 12:30 PT cutoff. Ping @devon @jamal :alarm_clock:

Devon: on my queue, will review now :eyes:

Jamal: can do but FYI e2e perf is flaky locally, failing on kv-cache warmup in stage. Link: https://ci.internal/1234

Sara: log excerpt:
```
E 03:14:22 kv_cache_warmup_timeout: timed out after 30s
WARN rolling back to cold-start path
```
Can reviewers focus on the cache patch in the PR description (lines 40-68)

Devon: I can approve if we add a fallback unit test and note the risk in the commit message. I'll push a review comment.

release-bot: preflight checks: build ✅, unit tests ✅, integration tests ❌ (flaky e2e). Current blockers: e2e-failure

Maria: tagging infra for quick heads up — @infra oncall, can we bump e2e timeout temporarily to unblock? :pray:

infra-oncall: we can increase timeout to 60s for this run, but let's not make it permanent. Scheduling now.

Jamal: thanks — with the timeout bump I can reproduce and will rerun CI. I expect to be able to LGTM in ~25m.

Sara: perfect. If Devon + Jamal can both LGTM by 12:25 PT we can merge before cutoff. I'll hold the merge train slot. :thumbsup:

Devon: left comment and approved after CI rerun looks green.

Jamal: approved. Great job — merging after final smoke.

release-bot: merged PR #9124 into release/rc2 at 12:28 PT. release-cutoff satisfied.
